built.D1: intake-evidence job kind in the existing job authority (jobs.ts registration branch, processing.ts dispatcher block); intake-evidence.ts stores and reads, intake-evidence-worker.ts reads one table or document under one key profile and writes coverage and candidates in the accepting transaction
built.D2: GET evidence, POST key-profiles and POST evidence confirmations answer from the store; the confirmation keeps every pin, refuses a stale pin with 409 INTAKE_EVIDENCE_STALE, returns registryWritten false with a note, and writes nothing to the registry
built.D3: candidate id and hash depend only on the profile, the source and the buildings, so sources read in any order give the same candidates and closure
built.D4: a table or document kept after a profile exists is queued under every profile of its case; a stored confirmation is unchanged and the read lists the sources read after it as newerSources

results.key: bin as written (integer kind: digits as written)
results.conflictExample: BIN 1002123 on two register rows, both conflicting in one group

documentCoverage.note: the footprint metadata names no BIN; a document never proposes absence

results.orderIndependence: register then metadata vs metadata then register with buildings reversed: identical candidate ids and hashes
results.staleConfirmation: profile, source revision, reading, unnamed newer source, candidate hash, package revision and link manifest each refuse

notBuilt: a table over 16 MiB (streamed CSV) stays coverage partial (read 0, other counts unknown): it needs G13's window read, a bounded read of every physical row of the retained original with its source row number, cell states as read and a result hash, callable by this reading's own job
a document is read from its latest accepted document-extraction job of the same source revision; the reading waits up to 30 minutes for one, then stays partial; it does not queue extraction itself
a building drafted after the key is not read back against earlier sources (late map side); left for the citation step
a map key held as a JSON number is never read as a key, since its spelling is lost on parse; a key path of the source feature id is refused
no runtime run: no database or Docker; the worker and stores are typechecked, and matching, closure, order and pin checks run on the real files
